question: In November 2022, Indian Coast Guard Advanced Light Helicopter Mk-III squadron. 840 Sqn (CG), commissioned in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Coast Guard Advanced Light Helicopter Mk-III squadron, 840 Sqn (CG)**, was commissioned in **Chennai **in** November 2022.**
 
• The squadron will be equipped with **16 advanced light helicopters**, which will enhance the** capabilities of the Indian Coast Guard** in conducting **maritime search and rescue operations, coastal surveillance, and interdiction missions.**
 
• The Advanced Light Helicopter Mk-III is a** multi-role helicopter** developed by** Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) **and is designed to operate from **ships and shore-based stations.**
 
• **Chennai **was chosen as the location for **commissioning the squadron **due to its strategic location on the east coast of India, which allows for quick response times to emergencies in the** Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanpur **is a city in Uttar Pradesh, **Puri** is a city in Odisha, and **Mysore **is a city in Karnataka
